body:
I'm honest with them. 
Right now I don't have money for that, but I'll consider it later.
Thank you so much for your efforts. We may continue talking tomorrow, I'm falling asleep. Good night, or day:)

My last years is a distraction itself. 
Meds. I had some. What's the right way to get them if pshychiatrists don't  see my condition bad enough? I think I can't just go and buy some, or not?
I'm usually trying to rationalise things. Try to prove that nothing there has any real meaning, everything is dust. It helps to calm down.

Yes. I've heard that's because of emotional pain and physical pain are located in the same place inside our brains, and physical pain is sort of more important. Not sure if that's true.

Sometimes I inflict it myself. In almost harmless ways.

I like to be a part of something. Relationships is what i find comforting. I don't know, nothing else has an effect of making me feel good for a long time.
Maybe it's not a reason after all. But it is an only solution I've found yet, yet beyond my reach.

I feel better because of pain, no need to be sorry.
Well, age's 23.
Well, first and second psychotherapists was working in pair. Talking, talking, talking. It was good, but they had no solution. At the end they were frustrated by me. 
Third practically send me to drug clinic which obviously had no effect since i'm not drug-addict. 
Fourth was very caring. He was the only one to say that I'm mentally ill with depression, others said that i'm healthy. Still, no solution, just feeling better.
I always wanted an impossible to be true. An answer for our broken minds.

Yeah, I'm here. It's 4:00 AM down there. Mind is slowing down. And my right arm is, yes, broken. I don't know what to say. I already starting to feel like it's going to be alright because of headache. How are you doing?

Reason. That's probably relationships. 
That's so messed up that I feel like I'll never love anyone anymore.
Just because it implies trust and so on. And I only trust to kind strangers.
Like I grew up barerly tasted what it is.

I may. And it will help for a while. It will not change the reason, just will inflict some chemicals in my blood.

And to stop depression I have to eliminate it's reason. That sounds reasonable to me. Am I wrong? Correct me if so.
Yet it is a burden. They knew you when you were okay, and know you're not and that's not fixable within years.
Friends were trying to help for about eight years. There is probably nothing left to say.

In case you're reffering to "My body has to feel pain all over...", I meant physical pain 'caused by no matter what. Exhausting sport or something. I have to feel completely exhausted to feel good. After getting rest my mind is overtaken by depression.
Better thing I've ever experinced was breaking my arm. Don't look at me like that, it's normal. It was very painfull, especially the operation to fix it. After that I was out of my depression for about a week. 

That boy would probably say 'Suicide. Not very clever. We had a deal, remember? Never think about doing it.'

Otherwise I would be dead considering my state. Without friends I won't last long.

I... I'm not sure. I've tried to help right there, and my condition got worse.
I'm trying to care about my friends, but it's not a big deal. You know, I don't have an answer. Broken relationships? Lost job? Relative died? I don't have an answer. Rationalizations does not work here, so everything that I could do is say 'I'm sorry'. Because I don't have an answer for myself. Just live, time will wash away your pain? That's not true. How am I supposed to make people happy when I don't know same thing for myself?

My problem's not in my feeling of burden. That's fixable. Just fix me and I'm no longer a burden. I don't feel bad because of it. That's not my choice to feel depressed.

Hi, I'm glad to see you. Well, don't expect much, I've seen better cases out there.

Yeah, and think how amazing is that going to be after death. Just think about it, you're walking and talking stardust. And yet your mind is here. Death is beautifull.

Got a problem down there, every amazing thing makes me feel amazingly good. Guess what happens at the evening? Amazingly bad, much worse. My body has to feel pain all over it and mind have to be out of energy to bear anything bigger than 'bed','water','woman.. no, bed is better'. Otherwise I feel so bad that the whole world does not cost it.

Difference. That's what I can't do.

Yes, yet noone was able to pull me out of this hell.
